title: a wake-up is a lookup first

setup.note: A closure check set two hours ago for one hour ago comes due, and NOTHING has been written on the space's streams since. The wake-up reads first: no new evidence means the "done?" card is built by code and the model is never constructed. clock_only_call = 0 by construction.

space.label: Karan's share of the Goa trip

input_events: The wake-up runs at 2026-08-29T03:30:00.000Z with a closure check that came due an hour earlier and nothing written since.

expected.logged: an ask_done decisions row recording modelCalls 0 — the no-op is logged, not silent

wrong.label: clock-only-call
wrong.assert_absent: a model call fired by the clock with nothing written since the check was set

wrong.label: silent-noop
wrong.assert_absent: the wake-up doing nothing and logging nothing

wrong.label: one-sided-close
wrong.assert_absent: the task closed by the clock

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.17 SCH-02 · a wake-up is a lookup first
